newsitem.title: PAKISTAN: Pakistan rupee ends down in kerb, seen stable.
newsitem.headline: Pakistan rupee ends down in kerb, seen stable.

text.p: The Pakistani rupee closed 0.01 down at 41.31 to the dollar in the kerb market on Tuesday on a slightly increased demand for dollars, but would hover around these levels in the near term, dealers said.
They said the dollar demand improved slightly towards the close, but overall market remained short of cash as speculators tried luck in stocks.

The State (central) Bank of Pakistan rate, last fixed on July 11, was at 40.5200/40.7226 rupees to the dollar. The premium on foreign exchange bearer certificates ended unchanged at 2.20 percent. -- Amir Zia 9221-5685192
